name: Scout v3
title: Scout v3
note: Scout built against the shared funnel (3 Nov): the Bee35 plate, the EMAX ECO II 2004 motors and Gemfan 3520 props, the FC on top of the plate (4 Nov), the tail electronics and the 4S 1500 pack from layout v3 / v12, the nose and tail units that hold the receiver, seat the Scout in the funnel and carry the camera, flow sensor and tail electronics (4 Nov, parts/scout_units_lib.py: engine setups, their drawn attachments and design rooms on the page until the runs land), and cage v18, a closed 3 mm rod octagonal prism of 27 nodes and 71 rods tangent to the prop keep-out, hung on the plate by 8 ties and its two end nodes printed into the units (tools/scout_cage.py: every member outboard of the funnel's walls on the whole descent, base rails at z 0, the cage lands on two skids at |y| 84 hung from the rails as Warren trusses braced to the ring (4 Nov, Spark: no standalone legs, the bottom triangulated, every node PETG), the ring at z 58 with a 12 dome ridge over it (4 Nov, Spark: the look), nose window for the camera; frame model tools/scout_cage_loads.py: first mode 232 Hz, a 35 g crash bends it under 0.2 mm except upside down on the roof 1.5, no rod over 0.54 of its Euler load), 266 x 230 x 118; the tail electronics stand on edge in the tail unit's bay over the tail runner, inside the funnel's bowl, and the camera just ahead of the front discs (4 Nov compact layout), so the cage's tail comes in to the rear discs' keep-out; the latch set stays off the page until the hold-down is designed; the units are designed to the receiver v3's inserts. Until 3 Nov the assembly placed the Overseer's folders for the cage, motors, props and flow sensor, so the page showed the Overseer's cage on the Scout (the migration of 28 Oct shared the folder names). v12 Scout manifest with the camera mount v1 (runs/scout_camera_mount/v1) in place of the layout's cradle, arms and clips. Layout v3 / cage v2 (27 Oct, Spark: the latest Scout layout (PR 94), a triangulated shell cage, the bottom ring exactly the Overseer's so the funnel is interchangeable, one camera, the carbon base kept; then every rod 3 mm, half the rods, any rod length) from nox/scout/v3/layout_v3.py. Rough layout: C geometry on E sizes. Drone frame: x nose, y left, z up, plate underside 18.5, thrust centre and tab line x 0. Left out: keep-alive contacts (the new funnel's), catch features, ESC (AIO).

openings.note: Spark 26 Oct rule: the front camera outside the cage, nothing of the drone in its view; cage first gated outside this cone
